sources.author_role: second author; co-corresponding author with Y. Qiang Sun
sources.access_level: full main text read; captions and Methods entry inspected
sources.summary: Uses controlled training-data removal, matched-size controls, basin transfer, and physical diagnostics. Discussion separates demonstrated findings from expectations for other models and types of extremes.
sources.limitations: Joint authorship; one principal AI architecture and one extreme-event family. Do not turn cross-model expectations into a demonstrated universal impossibility.

sources.summary: Moves from generalization performance to layer-selection surprise, interpretable spectral mechanisms, loss landscapes, and a practical framework. Discussion limits the best-layer result to examined systems and architectures.
